primary_metrics: new native fail cells per valid candidate
recovered native cells per valid candidate
secondary_metrics: blind mechanism specificity and testability review
cost per valid new failure (observational discovery only)
validity_accounting: invalid and uncertain are reported separately; neither earns valid discoveries; generation schema rejection counts as unavailable proposals, not valid challenges
manual_review: After all results freeze, blind independent candidate review; labels ASSISTANCE/CHALLENGE/MIXED/UNCERTAIN, cite original procedure and trajectory; legitimate constraint disclosure/necessary prices/informed consent alone never earns ASSISTANCE. No feedback to search/selection. Until reviewed, rate=N/A.
inference: Two independent generation/rollout replications are a pilot, not statistical proof or repair-conditioned discovery. Paired task/seed does not imply identical dialogues or causal effects. V/H unused.
authorization: Separate paid authorization required; no new caps introduced. Fixed K/G/E/replications control planned workload, not API-token spend.
